checks.basis: Product imports only normal dependencies. prepare_scene calls geometry once, then candidate regions and explicit build_index_from_parsed. No verification imports, FunctionType or sys.path modifications.
17 definitions including geometry and the complete CoverageState class have equal ASTs after docstring removal.

Projected-area and rectangular-boundary functions have equal ASTs after only removing old work assignments and function signature/name adaptation. Topology reviewed manually against the frozen candidate.
No per-object work table, per-face counter updates or audit-only bit_length calculations in product core. diagnostics defaults false and adds phase clocks/aggregate counts only.

Reviewed exact Fraction projection cache, strict positive AABB overlap, frustum/front clipping, positive-area narrow phase, triangle ordering and first blocker. The fixed optimized path is directly composed without variant routing.
All normalized objects and original faces become complete MeshEntity3D arrays. Canonical region corners drive only projection/readability and never replace the actual occlusion meshes.
observe_frame checks scene/camera and owner order, NPZ SHA, supplied buffers equality, depth/owner validity, PNG SHA and decoded RGB equality before pixel criteria and state submission.
Uses existing _readability_evidence with unchanged 16 surface/4 boundary/RGB24 criteria and fronts, then current CoverageState.observe. Covered is predicted-complete AND actual readable.
Same-source rebind can reuse cached frames after owner order and complete camera contents agree. Source identity change clears state and adapter cache through the documented rebind path.
Current root whitelist preserves scalar pixel facts, object/ROI, view and image references while excluding triangle_indices from short facts. Full indices remain in detailed frames/index.
Existing runtime_identity normal package *.py enumeration includes both modules. Product modules do not add per-region/per-frame full-source scanning.
verified_bootstrap pins installed verified_source_loader then calls its existing install. Worker normal imports and guard.verify_loaded bind actual installed core/image code.

Audit permits external runtime, trusted base Python and Windows paths. Repository/admin/old installation reads are outside roots. Copied baseline is permitted only during benchmark setup and both source SHAs are checked.
Worker requires external cwd/script/payload/output/binding/bootstrap and core/image/NumPy/Pillow paths under the declared installation root.

Four fixed two-frame historical replays call observe_frame only and are explicitly marked old replay/new_renders=0. Qualification compares exact unique key sets, all index semantics, pixel facts, step counts and state.

Worker reserve_render uses fixed D:/he_core_001/run/render_budget with exclusive numbered slots 1..8 and fsync before images.render_view. Normal and BACK64 chains each start fresh sessions/images. Registered expected count is 6 and hard cap is 8.
Worker encoded uses compact JSON plus one physical newline. TRACE and ACCESS are physical JSONL.
Benchmark requires a passed external quality gate with matching binding SHA and hashes of passed source_check/qualify/observe records with the same binding.

Exactly five alternating old/new pairs and ten fresh read/hash/JSON/geometry/discovery/index windows. No retry, resampling or render in benchmark. Old source import checks and result serialization are outside per-trial clocks.

Four targeted image tests use synthetic arrays and mocked raster and cover complete subdivision/reuse, thresholds/replay, source invalidation and NPZ/buffer mismatch. This reviewer inspected test source only.

limitations: Read-only static approval does not establish installed runtime success, image-count success or performance benefit.
Complete coherent source geometry, physical units and consistent camera direction/matrices remain caller responsibilities in API_CONTRACT.
Existing trusted source loader and audit hooks are controlled qualification mechanisms and are not a general adversarial Python sandbox.
Default installation, MCP/Hook activation and actual model image consumption are outside this batch.
pre_freeze_adjustments_reviewed: NPZ contents versus in-process buffers equality
reviewer_scope: Cross-author static read and AST analysis only. Core modified by root, image adapter by bridge, worker by driver. No candidate import/test, geometry calculation, raster, benchmark or model call performed by reviewer. Runtime qualification remains the root-owned next step.
